lengths.eot_convention: effective length = argmax(token ids) + 1 (the repository EOT rule); counting token_id != 0 would be wrong because a legal content token can be id 0
lengths.truncation_note: every input is checked before scoring: an input wider than the 248 positions is dropped, and the appended suffix must also pass a content-token test, so a cut-off suffix can never be scored as "the model ignored the suffix"

numerics_policy.encoding: eval() + torch.inference_mode(), FP32 parameters and FP32 forward, autocast disabled

pool.note: candidate order is the manifest order; every condition uses the same images and the same correct pairing, and no variant is mixed into another pool
